principles: Prefer local deterministic operations before model calls.
Never upload a user's media to a model provider without explicit per-project consent.
Treat browser storage as device-local, quota-limited, and not a backup.
Only label a capability active after a real endpoint or tool is available and verified.

engines.label: Browser media library
engines.notes: Original media and generated thumbnails are stored in browser IndexedDB. Browser storage can be cleared or quota-limited.

engines.label: Canvas compositor
engines.notes: Current implementation uses sequential cuts and a single title/subtitle treatment per shot. Separate audio tracks, masks, colour grading and transitions are not yet implemented.

engines.label: Web Audio source-audio capture
engines.notes: Captures audio that belongs to source video clips. It is not yet a multitrack music or narration mixer.

engines.label: FFmpeg.wasm
engines.decision: Do not load a large WASM core on the phone by default. Native browser recording is the initial render path; benchmark FFmpeg.wasm on real target devices before adding it.

engines.label: Video Ware
engines.decision: Do not install yet. It needs Node.js 22+, Yarn 4, FFmpeg, Redis and PocketBase; its optional visual analysis calls Google Cloud Video Intelligence. Evaluate its licensing, resource cost, and deployment fit before adoption.

engines.label: Native FFmpeg background worker
engines.decision: Use only after a persistent worker and authenticated job/file storage are provisioned. GitHub Actions is CI, not a guaranteed interactive rendering service.

engines.label: Blender render adapter
engines.decision: Reserve for a later motion-graphics milestone. Do not assume Blender is installed on the hosted runtime until a deployment check confirms it.

engines.label: Motion Canvas
engines.decision: Use as an optional specialised renderer for explanatory graphics after the core timeline contract stabilises.

engines.label: Consent-gated visual analyst and creative director
engines.notes: Uses the existing multimodal coordinator and configured model. Only up to six selected resized JPEG thumbnails are sent after explicit consent; provider/model identity is reported from the completed worker where available. This is not a post-render critic and does not implement between-shot transitions or audio tracks.
